statements.status_notes: Zot now bumps oras.land/oras-go/v2 to v2.6.1, the latest available v2 module release, which addresses the other open oras-go advisories. CVE-2026-50163 is still reported as affecting oras-go through v2.6.1, and no newer v2 module release is currently available. Reachability through Zot's ORAS artifact handling is still under investigation.
